title: Galaxy Tab S12 serisi tanıtıldı: İşte özellikleri ve fiyatı
summary: Samsung, gelişmiş performans ve profesyonel uygulama desteği sunan yeni amiral gemisi tabletleri Galaxy Tab S12+ ve Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra'yı duyurdu.
body:
SamMobile'ın aktardığına göre Samsung, en yeni amiral gemisi tabletleri Galaxy Tab S12+ ve Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra'yı 30 Eylül'de duyurdu. Daha hızlı performans, sarmal ses deneyimi ve güncellenmiş yazılım özellikleriyle gelen yeni seride, üretkenliğe odaklanan çeşitli profesyonel araçlar yer alıyor.

## Profesyonel uygulamalar ve Adobe Photoshop

SamMobile haberine göre cihazlar, Adobe Photoshop yazılımının tam sürümünü ön yüklü olarak sunan ilk Android tabletler olma özelliğini taşıyor. Tabletler ayrıca daha önceden yalnızca Apple platformlarında yer alan Notability uygulamasını da bünyesinde barındırıyor. Her iki uygulama da Samsung'un S Pen kalemi ve tablet ekranları için özel olarak optimize edilmiş durumda. Cihazlarla birlikte sunulan diğer bazı avantajlar şunları içeriyor:

- Adobe Photoshop için dört aylık mobil plan hediyesi.
- Clip Studio Paint için altı aylık ücretsiz deneme süresi ve ilk abonelikte %20 indirim.
- GoodNotes uygulamasına bir yıl boyunca ücretsiz erişim imkânı.

## Fiyatlandırma ve aksesuarlar

SamMobile'ın paylaştığı bilgilere göre Hindistan pazarındaki resmi listelemelerde tabletlerin fiyatları 1.29.999 Hindistan rupisinden başlayıp 1.84.999 Hindistan rupisine kadar yükseliyor. Ancak şirket, 16GB RAM ve 1TB depolama alanına sahip üst düzey Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra versiyonunu Hindistan'da satışa sunmayacağını belirtti. Aksesuar tarafında ise daha önce yalnızca Ultra modeline özel olan Pro Keyboard klavye aparatı, artık her iki Tab S12 modeli için de tercih edilebilecek. Alüminyum gövdeye ve izleme dörtgenine sahip bu klavye, kullanıcıların diledikleri yapay zeka asistanını hızla açmasını sağlayan özel bir tuşla birlikte geliyor.

**Neden önemli?** Yeni Galaxy Tab S12 serisi, masaüstü düzeyindeki profesyonel uygulamaları Android ekosistemine taşıması ve gelişmiş aksesuar seçenekleriyle mobil üretkenlik pazarında iddialı bir alternatif oluşturuyor.

source_texts.text:
The Galaxy Tab S12+ and Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra, Samsung's newest flagship tablets, were unveiled today. Both devices offer faster performance, more immersive audio, and upgraded software features. They also provide access to a robust suite of professional-grade apps for document creation, audio and video editing, digital art, and note-taking.
 
Both tablets come preloaded with Adobe Photoshop, making them the world's first Android tablets to run the full-fledged version of the software. They also include Notability, a popular note-taking app previously exclusive to Apple platforms. Both apps are fully optimized for Android tablets and Samsung's S Pen stylus.
 
- Adobe Photoshop: Comes pre-installed on the Galaxy Tab S12 series. Optimized for tablets and the S Pen. It also features an AI assistant and Generative AI-powered (Adobe Firefly) features such as Generative Fill and Image to Video. All Galaxy Tab S12 users get a 4-month mobile plan of the app.
- ArcSite: Converts rouch sketches into AI-powered CAD drawings.
- Clip Studio Paint: It is a digital drawing and painting app, and it offers a 6-month free trial and a 20% discount on the first subscription once the trial period ends.
- GoodNotes: It is a note-taking and idea organization app. It offers a 1-year free access to Galaxy Tab S12 series users.
- LumaFusion: It is an extremely popular pro-grade video editing app. It offers a 66% discount for Galaxy Tab S12 series users.
- MyScript Maths: Solves mathematical equations and offers a step-by-step explanations.
- MyScript Notes: A note-taking app that offers AI-powered tools to explain concepts, create quizzes, and summarizing handwritten notes.
- Notability: It is pre-installed on the Galaxy Tab S12 series and is optimized for tablets and the S Pen. It offers a six-month free trial and a 20% discount on the first paid subscription.
- Noteshelf 3: It offers customizable layouts for capturing ideas and organizing all your information.
- Notion: It is a note-taking, planning, and writing app. It offers a 1-month Plus plan for free for Galaxy Tab S12 series users.
 
In addition to these third-party tools, the tablets include Samsung Notes for sketching, journaling, and everyday list-making. Buyers also receive a complimentary six-month subscription to Google AI Pro.

Now, we have discovered listings for all the variants of both tablets on Samsung’s official website for India, revealing the prices of the complete lineup. Here’s how much they cost:
Interestingly, Samsung has not made the 16GB RAM + 1TB storage variant of the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra available in India. The variant is available in several other markets globally, making it an option for those who want the highest RAM and storage configuration.

source_texts.text:
Last updated: September 30th, 2026 at 17:37 UTC+02:00
A Pro Keyboard for each Tab S12 model!
Max Jambor / SamMobile
The Galaxy Tab S12+ and Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra were just unveiled, and along with the tablets themselves, Samsung also announced a handful of Tab S12 accessories.
The list is short, but there's one piece of fantastic news for productivity users who were hoping for a better Galaxy Tab S12+ experience: The Pro Keyboard attachment is no longer an Ultra-exclusive.
Samsung originally and exclusively released the Pro Keyboard for the Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra last year. This year, each Tab S12 model gets its own optional Pro Keyboard.
The aluminum-clad keyboard has a trackpad and it's the perfect accessory for Samsung DeX users. It also has a convenient Galaxy AI Key that will quickly launch your preferred AI assistant when pressed.
Full list of Galaxy Tab S12 accessories announced at launch:
NOTE: The S Pen is not optional. It's included in every Galaxy Tab S12+/Ultra box.
Pricing details are unknown. However, the Pro Keyboard will surely be the priciest accessory. For reference, the Tab S11 Ultra Pro Keyboard costs $399.
For Galaxy Tab S12+/Ultra users who want a cheaper keyboard attachment alternative, the Book Cover Keyboard Slim is it.
Whether this list is exhaustive or Samsung will create other accessories for the Galaxy Tab S12 series later is unknown.
The Galaxy Tab S12+ and Tab S12 Ultra will go on sale in select markets on October 7. Samsung hasn't specifically revealed any availability details for these Galaxy Tab S12 accessories, but there is a high likelihood that they'll hit the market on the same day.
